title: Sierra Vista, AZ — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Sierra Vista, AZ: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Sierra Vista is a city in AZ with a population of 43,000. Southern Arizona city near Fort Huachuca with affordable housing and mountain views. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year.
